notes.title: EA_V0.14
notes.content:
We are thrilled to introduce several significant improvements and new features with this update. Here are the key changes:

[b]Inventory System Overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*] The inventory system has been completely revamped. Now, all parts you disassemble from a motherboard will automatically be added to your inventory, and the full condition of the motherboard and its components will be preserved. This means that when you reassemble a motherboard, all parts will be intact and accounted for.
[*] Additionally, motherboards with missing parts can no longer be installed, ensuring that all components are present before assembly.
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Each part now retains its own durability value, providing a more realistic and detailed inventory management experience.
[/list]

[b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Various critical bug fixes and performance improvements have been implemented to enhance your gaming experience.
[/list]

We hope these changes will make your gameplay more engaging and enjoyable. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Happy gaming!


[b]Note:[/b] You may need to cancel your job after the update for some changes to take effect!
